item.tib: gsang chen rol pa zang thal gyi 'phrin las gsang ba mthar thug gi cha lag zur byang rin chen mdzes pa'i phreng ba
item.coloph: kho bo o rgyan bde chen gling pa'am/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis sprul pa'i gnas chen brgyad kyi nang tshan rig chen 'bar ba'i mthil na phab pa bkra shis//
